figures.caption: Fig. 4. Overview of CoRePrune. Stage 1 progressively prunes visual tokens using depth-refreshed local perturbation scores. Stage 2 reevaluates the remaining candidates using query- and set-conditioned rescue benefits and reduces the sequence to the final KL visual tokens.
